text: Build step 6 of the build order in docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 12: the labeled set and its scoring (sections 10.2 and 10.3), as a read-only command that the user runs over the real records after landing (agents' copies leave out records/). It builds the labeled set from introspection records whose class a person has reviewed, scores Jev's recorded shadow answers against those labels with the scoring rule in section 10.3, and reports the score with its sample size and interval, plus the promotion verdict from section 10.4. With too few labeled cases it must say so and give no verdict, rather than a confident score. Verify with the fake Jev and fixture records in a temporary directory.
